description:
[Taxonomy II.21 — baseline response (public data only)] For a given CPT, surface the ICD-10 codes typically paired with it for medical-necessity support.

WHEN TO USE: User has a CPT code and wants to know what ICD-10 diagnoses commonly pair with it for medical-necessity support.

WHEN NOT: For specific payer policy lookups (code_validation).

EXAMPLES:
- Common ICDs for 99213: `{"cpt_code":"99213"}`

cpt_code.description: Single CPT/HCPCS code, e.g. '99213'. Returns common ICD-10 pairings from the public co-occurrence table.

name: cpt_to_icd_mapper
